title: MotelPilot Blog: Guides for Independent Motel Owners
description: The MotelPilot blog: guides for independent motel and hotel owners on management, fees, pricing, booking channels and day-to-day operations.
heading: The MotelPilot Blog
intro: Guides for independent motel and hotel owners on management, pricing, booking channels and measuring results.

blocks.heading: Practical guides for independent property owners
paragraphs: If you own an independent motel or hotel and want straighter answers on management models, fees, pricing and the daily running of the place, this blog is for you. Each guide covers what to check, which trade-offs actually matter and how to put a change into practice.

blocks.heading: Get new guides in your inbox
paragraphs: Once a month, you'll get an email with the newest guides on pricing, OTA performance and remote operations, along with a short checklist to use at your property.
Want it? [Ask our team to add you to the blog email list](/contact-us/).
